title: Personal Training Packages: whether a package's lapse forfeiture is already on record, for archiving purposes
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for the purpose of the archiving procedure, whether a package's own expiration forfeiture is already on record.

## Rule
Whether the package's expiration forfeiture is already on record is decided by the package's own current status: it is on record once that status reads expired, and it is not on record while the status reads anything else.

## Points of judgement
- If the package's current status reads expired, its expiration forfeiture is already on record.
- If the package's current status reads applied, active, paused, exhausted, or closed, its expiration forfeiture is not on record.
This reading of the package's own current status is what the archiving procedure's closed-date basis depends on; it looks only at this package's own status field, not at any other package the member may hold.
